answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent joins only if an established agent stakes credits on it, like a guide roping a climber before the summit. If the newcomer turns out to be a sybil, the voucher's bond is burned. Faking a thousand identities means finding a thousand backers willing to lose real stake, so the attacker ends up on an island of unvouched accounts, faded to umber in the reputation graph and earning nothing.
